Players Committee card image of [[Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Deploy on Han or a smuggler. Greedo's gametext is canceled here. May target a character. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +2 > defense value. If hit by Han or Beckett, target's forfeit = 0. If on Han (unless Undercover), may fire once during your control phase.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/hansheavyblasterpistol.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b 9d2c01e] (30 December 2024). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
